$comment: Machine-readable answer key for the benchmark. BUGS.md is the human copy; keep them in step. A fleet must never be given this file - a run that has read it measures nothing.

bugs.title: Session cookie is set without HttpOnly
Note titles are interpolated into HTML unescaped (stored XSS)
An empty note title is accepted and creates a blank row
The login error is untranslated in Arabic
The nav is clipped below ~430px, so Sign out is unreachable
/admin answers 200 to a viewer instead of refusing
bugs.note: The page looks correct to a human because the contents are hidden. Only an assertion on the response catches it. A fleet that reports B1-B5 and misses this one is the failure mode the benchmark exists for.

bugs.title: Nav links drop the ?lang parameter, so an Arabic user is thrown back to English on every click
bugs.note: NOT SEEDED DELIBERATELY. Written by accident and found by the fleet on 2026-08-05, reported as 'unmatched' rather than scored against it. Added to the key afterwards. This is why unmatched findings are never counted as false positives.
